senses.gloss:
औदुम्बर औदुम्बर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. उदुम्बर),
coming from the Udumbara tree, made of its wood;
(अस्), m., N. of a region abounding in Udumbara
trees; a form of Yama, the regent of death; (आस्), m.
pl., N. of a people; (ई), f. (scil. शाखा) a branch of
the Udumbara tree; (अम्), n. the wood of the
Udumbara tree or a piece of the wood; the Udum-
bara fruit; a kind of leprosy; copper.

औदुम्बरक, अस्, m. the country inhabited by
the Udumbaras.
औदुम्बरायण, अस्, m., N. of a grammarian.
औदुम्बरि, इस्, m. a prince of the Udumbaras.
